description.value:
The war-winning Dragoon, rebuilt on the lessons of the Unification War. Militech's idea is one soldier doing the work of a shield wall, with software that finds the crack in whatever's in front of it. The weapon package is sold separately, which tells you who the customers are.

Cost: 39,400eb (Super Luxury)
Humanity Loss: 76 (23d6)
Frame: Omega (16): BODY 16
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Chrome: Anti-Dazzle ×2, Combat Software (Vulnerability Analytics), Dragoon Plating, Enhanced Holophone, FBC EMP Coating ×2, Internal Hydraulics Upgrade (Tuned), Low Light/Infrared/UV ×2, Reinforced Cyberlimb Upgrade ×4, Subdermal Grip ×2

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Drop it on a character (as GM) to install it with Go Metal.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
